review.official:
Banished from her community for being
Infected
, she has made a living as a mercenary in the criminal underworld. She is skilled in matters best left unsaid, and as a result of the base nature of the work has become known as "Scavenger." Since her introduction to
Rhodes Island
through an intermediary, she has given up her mercenary life to become an
Operator
.

files.description:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 12% 
Operator has no obvious Originium crystals externally, however, tests have revealed an abundance of crystals internally. The limbic system of the brain has been particularly affected, and the Operator's personality changes are suspected to be related to this.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.29u/L
Due to high presence of Originium within the internal organ's, the Operator's circulatory system has a high Originium content.

Having been exiled by her tribe, betrayed by her client, and endured all manner of hardships, Scavenger prefers to act alone and is wary of others. Moreover, since her personality has been affected by Originium, she has become difficult to communicate with. Perhaps she'll open up a bit once she gets used to working at Rhodes Island.

Scavenger moves freely in harsh environments and will eat almost anything as long as it won't kill her. She is one of the most adaptable Operators, of truly unparalleled versatility. When given the chance, she enjoys resting in dark corners or eating a few specific foods.

Scavenger prefers to avoid other operators until it's not required for her work, with the exception of Provence. She tends to sneer at those who ask her about her interest in Provence, which is reflective of some sort of attraction. While Provence is considered generally attractive (many Operators particularly enjoy fluffing her tail), Scavenger seems to be interested in something else....

Scavenger once loved a young woman from her own tribe, who reciprocated her feelings. For whatever reason, they did not express their feelings to one another until Scavenger became Infected and was banished from her tribe. The next time Scavenger was able to meet the young lady, she had already passed away and with her the knowledge of their forbidden love. This memory is a keepsake that Scavenger will forever hold close to her heart.

No one understands why a covert mercenary would use such a heavy weapon for sneak attacks, as it is clearly unsuitable. Despite this disadvantage, Scavenger still manages to operate effectively. When others see her pass by, they typically come under the impression that she is not an assassin so much as an individual who will stop at nothing to eliminate everything in her path. No one doubts her abilities, and as for the actual truth behind her choice of weaponry? Who cares.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Better to get your job done first than wasting time on chitchat.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You'd better remember that failing to adapt makes you a useless burden.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Work, eat, run, repeat. Big fricking whoop. Isn't that how life is for anyone these days?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My job was to take care of 'troubles' for my employers. Eventually they started to call me Scavenger.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Just like the two sides of a coin, no matter how splendid the face is, the backside is always stained with dirt.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've adapted to this place really well since I joined? Pfft, rubbish. It's just that I've gotten used to working on the surface.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: That's Provence, isn't it…? The wretched girl who got Infected while rescuing people from a Catastrophe... Look at that massive tail she's got...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You know, Doctor... I hated the idea of working with other people, at first. I figured our methods would clash. But at some point, I came to realize that's not the case.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: If only she were still alive... Now all I can do is carry on alone, carrying her dreams on my back.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: How can you sleep so soundly when you're defenseless…?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Scavenger. Leave the dirty work to me. Just pay me like my other employers and we'll be good.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: No, it's not enough...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: This still isn't enough. I need to become stronger...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thanks, Doctor. I feel like I have a reason to fight now.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Do I need to quip just 'cause I joined the team?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't you hold me back.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Conceal yourselves so the enemy won't find you.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hmph, time for a clean up.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hurry up.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Are we doing this?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Tch.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I know what to do.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Garbage.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Keep writhing in the gutter!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: There is no turning back for you!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You get no sympathy!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Gotta say that mission was a special one.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Hmph. They have only their own weakness to blame.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Tch, some of them got away. I'm disappointed in you.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Dammit! Screwed up again...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Just give me a dark corner.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Argh! Let go of me!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: What? You want me to dispose of you too?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's? Tsk, just another day, nothing different. But if you need a reminder, crowded places mean more stupid crap can happen, so don't get too lost in the fun, okay?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You got a job for me?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I did use to take birthdays seriously... but who's out there still counting every year they live these days...? Whatever. If you'd like, I could wish for you to have fun today or something.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Ugh. Just waiting for you to clear out before I grab some cheese from in there. What? My job's never been anything but cleaning up the filthiest of places. Telling me my name's gonna show up on your honor roll?
